**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical observation — NO
T2. Forward-looking immediate — YES *(winter 2026/27 supply-demand balance)*
T3. Long-term development — NO

**Synopsis:**
NESO issued its early winter outlook, confirming Britain has adequate electricity supply despite Iran-war disruptions to Strait of Hormuz energy flows. Gas-fired generation (~30% of UK power mix) remains secure as Qatari LNG exposure is minimal (~1% of UK gas supply). De-rated margin is forecast at 5.5 GW (8.8% of peak demand), in line with recent winters. UK remains a net power importer, with domestic prices expected above continental European levels. US-Iran peace talks are ongoing.
